one_liner: Bite-size daily practice for board exams and spoken English, in your own language.
description: PadhoPlus gives students 10-minute daily practice sets for Class 10/12 boards and a spoken-English coach for job interviews. Questions explained in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali. Doubt-solving by photo, streaks and weekly mock tests. Works on low data.
key_features: 10-minute daily practice sets for Class 10 and 12 boards
Spoken-English interview coach with instant feedback
Explanations in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali
Weekly mock tests and streaks; works on 2G/low data
usp: Exam and English practice explained in your mother tongue, in 10 minutes a day.
target_audience: Class 9-12 students and fresh graduates in tier-2 and tier-3 cities, and their parents
